originating_goal: Reach the minimum technically necessary hosted validation surface while ensuring no non-TV/TVC secret or token is used and preserving deterministic architecture and cross-platform capability validation.

standalone_exception_basis.necessity: cross-platform Ubuntu/Windows/macOS x Python 3.11/3.12 portability matrix cannot be represented by the single Ubuntu stable dispatcher without losing portability validation coverage
standalone_exception_basis.credential_boundary: permissions empty, explicit GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_PAT and TVC/protected-token refusal, anonymous exact-SHA fetch, no checkout/setup/upload actions, no repository writeback, no activation effect

collision_boundaries: Do not replace architecture validation with another token-backed action chain.
Do not remove cross-platform capability coverage unless equivalent deterministic portability validation remains.
Do not inject TV/TVC protected values into GitHub Actions.
Do not compete with resident carrier, Healer scheduler, TVC private-review, or StegFin USER_ONLY authority.
Do not manufacture activation, provider, publication, Site, Master Records, or trade evidence.
next_task_after_release: Determine whether any unique session support requirement remains outside canonical worker-owned activation/trade paths; if none, consolidate and archive.
